panels.description: Progress toward harvest for this bay (0–100%). Growth duration is 300s — keep in sync with `FARM_PLANT_GROWTH_SECONDS` in `app/constants.py`.
panels.title: Plot 1 growth

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN crop_ready_at IS NULL THEN 0::double precision
    WHEN crop_ready_at <= NOW() THEN 100::double precision
    ELSE LEAST(
      100::double precision,
      GREATEST(
        0::double precision,
        100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (crop_ready_at - INTERVAL '300 seconds'))) / 300.0
      )
    )
  END AS progress
FROM bunker_crop_plots
WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND plot_index = 0

panels.title: Plot 1 Estimated Yield
panels.description: Estimated harvest for this bay: current worker assignment if fallow; otherwise running average during growth. Align 50/10 with `FARM_HARVEST_YIELD` / `FARM_HARVEST_YIELD_REF_AVG_WORKERS`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN p.crop_ready_at IS NULL THEN
      GREATEST(0::double precision, 50.0::double precision * (COALESCE(bp.count, 0)::double precision / 10.0))
    WHEN p.crop_planted_at IS NULL THEN
      GREATEST(0::double precision, 50.0::double precision * (COALESCE(bp.count, 0)::double precision / 10.0))
    ELSE
      GREATEST(0::double precision, 50.0::double precision * (
        (
          p.growth_worker_seconds::double precision
          + COALESCE(bp.count, 0)::double precision
            * GREATEST(
                0::double precision,
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.crop_ready_at - GREATEST(NOW(), p.crop_planted_at)))
              )
        )
        / GREATEST(
          EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.crop_ready_at - p.crop_planted_at)),
          1e-9
        )
      ) / 10.0::double precision)
  END AS expected_yield
FROM bunker_crop_plots p
LEFT JOIN bunker_farming_systems fs ON fs.user_id = p.user_id
LEFT JOIN bunker_professions bp ON bp.id = fs.profession_line_id
WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND p.user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND plot_index = 0

panels.title: 🌾 Farm management
panels.description: Farm workers and rat trappers share the bunker population with power crank workers. Four hydro bays (2×2); harvest size scales with mean farm workers during each crop's growth window.

options.content:
Farm workers: –
Rat trappers: –

Each hydro bay has Plant/Harvest controls above. Farm workers improve harvest size only (see bays above). Rat trappers recover spilled grain continuously—proportionally to how hungry the rat swarm would make residents—and fully suppress the silo rat incident once trap output meets or exceeds that raid drain.

Routine compartment sweep

Assigning farm workers does not reduce loyalty. Workers assigned here and on the Power dashboard cannot exceed bunker population.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, level FROM food_reserves WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT NOW() AS time, bp.count AS food_workers
FROM bunker_farming_systems f
JOIN bunker_professions bp ON bp.id = f.profession_line_id
WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND f.user_id = '$user_id'::uuid

SELECT NOW() AS time, bp.count AS rat_trappers
FROM bunker_farming_systems f
JOIN bunker_professions bp ON bp.id = f.rat_trapper_line_id
WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND f.user_id = '$user_id'::uuid

panels.title: Food stores over time
panels.description: Total bunker food stockpile from each game tick.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, level AS "Food stores" FROM food_reserves WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Food production and consumption
panels.description: Instantaneous rates (food units per second) per tick: population consumption vs passive lines on this tick (farm workers only boost hydro harvest payouts; rat trapper recovery scales with marginal rat-event drain—see constants/events tuning).

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, consumption_per_second AS "Consumption per s" FROM food_reserves WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp
SELECT timestamp AS time, production_per_second AS "Production per s" FROM food_reserves WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp
